page_title: MAI 0-1 FRE | Mainz v Freiburg 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+6' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Mainz can continue in their attacking effort.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz).
90+4' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+3' Daniel Batz (Mainz) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. Mainz force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+2' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) takes the corner with a short pass.

90+2' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Daniel Batz is alert and denies him with a nice save. Now Freiburg have a corner.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Anthony Caci (Mainz) commits a rough foul. Tobias Stieler stops the game and makes a call.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Roland Sallai (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) will take the free kick.
87' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) brings his opponent down. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
86' Jan Siewert has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danny da Costa (Mainz) replacing Silvan Widmer.
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tom Krauss will be replaced by Dominik Kohr (Mainz).
86' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
86' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) will take a corner kick.

85' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Mainz will have a corner.
84' That's the end of the game for Ritsu Doan, who is replaced by Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
84' Here is a change. Michael Gregoritsch is going off and Christian Streich gives the last tactical orders to Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
82' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
79' The shots on goal statistics – 6:2.
79' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
76' Jan Siewert prepares a substitution. Brajan Gruda is replaced by Aymen Barkok (Mainz).
76' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee did his best and is replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
75' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
69' 0 - 1 Goal! Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
68' Tom Krauss (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' Tom Krauss (Mainz) picks up an injury.
67' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
66' Substitution. Marco Richter makes his way off the pitch and Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) comes on as his replacement.

64' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Freiburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

61' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Noah Atubolu easily makes the save.
61' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
59' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Noah Weisshaupt.
59' Tom Krauss (Mainz) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
58' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
57' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
54' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
52' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Noah Atubolu.
51' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
50' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is caught offside!
49' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
48' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+7' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Noah Atubolu, who pulls off a stunning save! Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
45+6' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45+6' Marco Richter (Mainz) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45+5' Mainz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

45+2' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

45' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Mainz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Freiburg are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
40' Marco Richter (Mainz) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
38' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
34' The cross into the penalty area from Marco Richter (Mainz) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
33' Tobias Stieler blows the whistle, Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is penalised for a foul.

32' Mainz slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
31' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
29' Tobias Stieler shows a yellow card to Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
28' A clumsy foul by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle.
28' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
27' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the left post!
25' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
24' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Gulde is coming onto the pitch as Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
23' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.

23' Daniel Batz makes a brilliant save! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper! The referee points to the corner flag and Freiburg will take a corner.
22' Freiburg take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
21' Poor challenge! Marco Richter (Mainz) is penalised for tripping and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Freiburg.
21' Freiburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
20' 8:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
18' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) takes a short corner kick.
18' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

18' Noah Atubolu was forced into action to thwart Leandro Barreiro (Mainz). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner.

17' Ambitious effort from Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
16' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
12' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) makes a strong challenge and Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.

9' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Mainz are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
7' This shall not pass! Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
6' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

Mainz will kick the game off.
